name: AMR spatial-resolution convergence
purpose: Establish that spatial discretization error is below the declared M1 science tolerances for a stationary physical problem.
production_capability: Input-driven production AMR, frozen-epoch SPICE environment, normal particle mover, sources, surface interactions, and science samplers.
configuration: Reviewed sphere-mode FULL M1 receipt; QUICK/CUSTOM inputs rejected before launch; simulation_environment_mode=frozen; 40, 20, 10, and 5 km campaign levels; fixed seeds and one declared MPI/OpenMP layout.
inputs: four derived and archived resolution receipts
independent_reference: Successive-resolution convergence, stationary-block statistics, and the invariant that repeated production steps retain identical external SPICE/frame state.
units: metres, seconds, number density per cubic metre, return flux per square metre per second, column density per square metre, Rayleigh
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO; MOON_ME_DE421 body controls; all external environment quantities frozen at the receipt UTC converted to TDB ET.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Production random seed 731993; one explicitly recorded positive MPI rank count and OpenMP=1 at every resolution; adaptive non-overlapping batch means with lag-one significance bound 1.96/sqrt(N); four independent means for three equilibrium changes followed by five disjoint science means.
procedure: Derive and archive 40/20/10/5 km receipts by scaling the surface, near-surface, angular, and polar targets while keeping physical extents and far/outer targets fixed; verify the frozen production environment; run without a time/resource cap while monitoring process-tree and block resource use; MPI-reduce all production-owned samples; double batch duration until lag-one correlation is insignificant; require three <=2% equilibrium changes; compute Student-t 95% confidence intervals from five following independent batches; compare the complete common scoring vector, including six fixed 30-degree SZA return-flux bands, across successive resolutions.
acceptance_criteria: External-state drift exactly zero; equilibration <=2% for three consecutive blocks; at least five independent science blocks; 95% CI half-width <=1.67% integrated and <=3.33% pointwise; successive-resolution change <5% integrated and <10% pointwise.
expected_pass_result: The finest retained M1 mesh has quantified numerical and statistical error below every declared tolerance.
required_data: campaign-generated outputs only; no observational data
data_hashes: SPICE, input, executable, and every derived receipt/output hash are required in run manifests.
status_semantics: PASS requires the complete four-resolution campaign. FAIL means a fully evaluated wiring or convergence criterion failed. Statistical uncertainty alone does not terminate the unbounded run: unresolved required bins continue sampling. Build/runtime/parser/resource exhaustion, interruption, or corrupt/missing artifacts are ERROR. SKIPPED is reserved for a genuinely unavailable prerequisite or production capability.
